{{Quote|It is I, ''Head Elder Kazak'', Wicket, the scout!|[[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] to Kazak|<ref name="E13" />}}
'''Head Elder''' was a title of the [[Bright Tree Village tribe]] of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], held by the Ewok [[Kazak]]<ref name="E13" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Ewoks (1985)|''Ewoks'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which include the events of [[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' 13]], to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>
